summary: Completed comprehensive UI-FREEZE-1 testing of Telegram module redesign. All major features working correctly according to Figma reference including Entities Overview table, Channel Overview page, activity badges, FOMO scores, and compare modal functionality.

design_issues.issue: Red flag icons not displaying in entity table despite data having redFlags values

All 8 required table columns present and functional
Channel navigation working - clicking entities navigates to detail page
Channel Overview page loads with all 10 required components
Top Cards showing Subscribers, Views/Post, Messages/Day, Activity
Compare modal opens and closes correctly with detailed comparison data
View on Telegram button configured with proper external link
Engagement Timeline with time range buttons (24H, 7D, 30D, 90D)
